dog.description_text:
Meet Lumi!

This sweet 3-year-old girl has a social personality and loves meeting new people. She's dog-friendly and enjoys getting out for walks. Lumi has a great balance of energy and relaxation—she loves playtime and having fun, but can also settle down easily when it's time to relax. Whether you're heading out for an adventure or enjoying a quiet afternoon together, Lumi would love to be by your side. She's ready to find a loving home to call her own!

If Lumi sounds like the perfect addition to your family, click the "Adopt Me" button to learn more!

. *You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.
